name: Nicanor
description: Chosen by Lysias with Ptolemee the son of Dorymenes and Gorgias to go into the land of Juda; later sent by king Demetrius with great force against Judas, bore deadly hate unto Israel, dealt deceitfully, mocked the priests and vowed to burn the temple, and was slain in battle at Adasa, his head and right hand brought to Jerusalem

points: The king sent Nicanor, one of his honourable princes, a man that bare deadly hate unto Israel, with commandment to destroy the people. He came to Judas and his brethren deceitfully with friendly words: let there be no battle between me and you; I will come with a few men, that I may see you in peace. But the enemies were prepared to take away Judas by violence. When Judas knew he came with deceit, he was afraid of him and would see his face no more.

note.label: Blasphemers & Traitors: Judge Not Before the Time

points: When Nicanor saw his counsel was discovered, he went out to fight against Judas, and there were slain of Nicanor's side about five thousand men. Judas Maccabaeus was a fighter, a warrior.

note.label: Blasphemers & Traitors: Judge Not Before the Time

points: Certain of the priests and elders, who had not yet heard of the conflict, came out to salute Nicanor peaceably and to shew him the burnt sacrifice offered for the king. But he mocked them, laughed at them, abused them shamefully, and spake proudly, and sware in his wrath: unless Judas and his host be now delivered into my hands, if ever I come again in safety, I will burn up this house. Bring me Judas, or I burn this temple to the ground.

note.label: Blasphemers & Traitors: Judge Not Before the Time

points: Nicanor planned to pay Rome's tribute by selling captive Jews, not expecting the vengeance of the Almighty.
Judas and his brethren slew many of Nicanor's host and took the money of those who came to buy them.

note.label: False New Year: True Past Curses & Trauma

points: Then the heathen that had fled out of Judea from Judas came to Nicanor by flocks, thinking the harm and calamities of the Jews to be their welfare.

note.label: The Pit and Pendulum: The Slow Genocide of the Undesired

points: Now when the Jews heard of Nicanor's coming, and that the heathen were up against them, they cast earth upon their heads, and made supplication to him that had established his people for ever, and who always helpeth his portion with manifestation of his presence.

note.label: The Pit and Pendulum: The Slow Genocide of the Undesired

points: Judas, who was ever the chief defender of the citizens, commanded to strike off Nicanor's head, and his hand with his shoulder, the arm he had stretched out against the temple, and bring them to Jerusalem.

note.label: Blasphemers & Traitors: Judge Not Before the Time

points: He shewed them vile Nicanor's head, and the hand of that blasphemer, which with proud brags he had stretched out against the holy temple of the Almighty. And he cut out the tongue of that ungodly Nicanor, commanded to give it by pieces unto the fowls, and hanged up the reward of his madness before the temple. The tongue that talked the blasphemy was cut out and fed to the birds, and every man praised the glorious Lord, saying, blessed be he that hath kept his own place undefiled.
